verdict.rationale: The evidence documents agent wallets (Agentic Accounts) and payment schemes, but no per-agent spend caps, usage limits, or instant revocation of an agent's payment authority. The 'upto' scheme's per-request maximum and batch settlement's signed escrow limits and refund/withdrawal semantics are adjacent protocol mechanics, not buyer-side agent governance controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set per-agent spend caps and usage limits and revoke an agent's payment authority instantly
